title: Personal Deposit Fee Schedule: Savings and Money Market Monthly Maintenance
content:
### Monthly maintenance fee and the waivers offered, by tier

The monthly maintenance fee of Savings & Money Market Accounts is a per-tier figure assessed at statement cycle close. Each tier separately sets which waiver parameters it offers. A waiver parameter carrying the value not offered is not available on that tier at all.

| Tier | Monthly maintenance fee | Lowest end-of-day balance in the cycle | Automatic transfer posted in the cycle | Owner younger than | Active linked checking tier held at cycle close | Relationship balance at cycle close |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Starter Savings | 5.00 USD | 300.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 25 years | not offered | not offered |
| Statement Savings | 5.00 USD | 300.00 USD | 25.00 USD | not offered | Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | not offered |
| Goal Builder Savings | 0.00 USD | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered |
| Money Market Account | 12.00 USD | 2500.00 USD | not offered | not offered | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 15000.00 USD |
| Premier Money Market | 20.00 USD | 10000.00 USD | not offered | not offered | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 25000.00 USD |
| Private Client Money Market | 25.00 USD | 100000.00 USD | not offered | not offered | Private Client Checking | 250000.00 USD |

### What each column means

The balance column gives the lowest end-of-day balance during the cycle at or above which the fee is waived. The automatic transfer column gives the amount an automatic transfer from checking must reach, posted in the cycle, for the waiver to be met. The age column gives the age below which the owner is waived at cycle close. The linked checking column lists the checking tiers an active account of which, held by the same customer at cycle close, waives the fee. The relationship balance column gives the relationship balance at cycle close at or above which the fee is waived.

### Reading the schedule

Goal Builder Savings carries a maintenance fee of 0.00 USD and offers no waiver parameter, because there is no charge for a waiver to remove.

The balance waiver figures rise steeply with the tier: 300.00 USD on the two entry tiers, 2500.00 USD on Money Market Account, 10000.00 USD on Premier Money Market and 100000.00 USD on Private Client Money Market. On a hypothetical Money Market Account whose lowest end-of-day balance in the cycle was 2500.00 USD exactly, the balance parameter is reached, since the column is stated as at or above; at 2499.99 USD it is not.
